surface_mechanism_description: The oxide consumption operates through ligand exchange reactions at the HfO2 surface with organic-amide precursors. Ga and As species diffuse through the thin HfO2 layer and undergo a substitution reaction with the Hf precursors, which in turn volatilizes the Ga or As species.
